title: Azeon: Precision-trained AI agents for high-volume customer service | Product Hunt
excerpt: Azeon delivers agentic AI customer support across chat, email, and voice, with deep integration into billing, payment, eCommerce, ERP, and business systems.
content_html:
Multi-Agent AI for BFSI Support

Launched this week

Resolution-first multi-agent AI for BFSI customer support

Azeon runs a coordinated set of AI agents built for BFSI. One retrieves client history and compliance logs, one detects stress signals in high-stakes conversations, one tracks the client's journey from onboarding to renewal, and one keeps every response compliant. Together they resolve transaction queries, disputes, KYC requests, and policy questions end-to-end, not just answer them.

Free Options

用于 BFSI 客户支持的分辨率优先的多代理 AI

Azeon 运行一组为 BFSI 构建的协调人工智能代理。 一项任务检索客户历史记录和合规日志，一项任务检测高风险对话中的压力信号，一项任务跟踪客户从入职到续约的整个过程，一项任务确保每一个响应都合规。 他们共同解决交易查询、争议、KYC 请求和端到端的政策问题，而不仅仅是回答它们。
